title: Jacquard loom
alt: Tall wooden Jacquard loom with textile, mechanical frame, and punched-card control apparatus visible.
caption: A Jacquard loom: worker, mechanism, encoded instruction, and output joined in one machine system.
teachingUse: Supports the distinction between a tool and an automated system that reorganizes labor and control.
